Name: Breezy Hills Farm
Author: windvalley
Description:
[b]
Features
[/b][list]
[*]  ﻿[b]Update 1.3[/b] New config option that changes the ladder into another hill.
[/list][list]
[*] Comes with a choice between stream or pond for the bottom left of the farm.
[/list][list]
[*] ﻿A new farm type
[/list][list]
[*] Forest Forage
[*] Respawning stumps﻿
[*] A custom starting house layout
[*] ﻿Forest Fish available in the bottom left pond if the "pond" option is selected
[/list]
[b]Config[/b]

Layout: Changes the body of water on the bottom left of the farm; choose between "stream" or "pond." The stream option has more space and 4 hardwood stumps. The pond option has less space and only two hardwood stumps, but you can catch forest fish in it. [b]Only change this option on a new save file
[/b]
Extra Hilly: Replaces the ladder to the bottom left of the map into another slope. Purely aesthetic. Best chosen on a new farm.
[b]
Installation
 
 [/b]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets.
[/url]Download and then extract into your Stardew Valley mods folder.
[b]
Mods Pictured
[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164?tab=description]Simple Foliage[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage - Unofficial Update for 1.6[/url]﻿
[/list][b]
Important note for update 1.2

[/b]If you install this update while you currently have a save file using this map, it is recommended to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]this mod[/url] to be able to fully use the ladder near grandpa's shrine.
